page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-8-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the c4d family. It is configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs and 31.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per core. The instance configuration includes 1 local SSD as indicated by its basic description, while structured local storage size is listed as None. It does not feature any graphics processing units and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This instance relies on dedicated CPU allocation to ensure consistent compute performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core environments. While benchmark data for this specific configuration is currently unavailable, the hardware profile represents a balanced resource density. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated resource allocation and standard memory-to-vCPU ratio position this server as a stable option for workloads requiring predictable execution times without the premium cost of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware classes.

The c4d-standard-8-lssd is suited for general-purpose workloads, including medium-scale web serving, application servers, containerized microservices, and continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines. The combination of 8 dedicated vCPUs and 31 GB of RAM provides sufficient capacity for multi-threaded application environments and moderate database operations that do not require extreme memory footprints.
